nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: The deeds went home this morning. Old Weatherby held his up to the light for ten minutes like it might evaporate.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Behaving? Good. Wind it gently. It's a precision instrument, not a doorknob.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: That's what I said. He's framing it anyway. Farmers.
